Overview

Illusionist (Final) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable through evolution by evolving Illusionist (Fusion).

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Attacks starting from Upgrade 9 are able to hit air type enemies.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Active Ability: Illusion

On activation, Illusionist will summon an illusion that pushes back any enemies on contact, this state lasts for 10 seconds and takes 6 minutes / 360 seconds to recharge.

Trivia

  • At Update 11.5, his ability duration got nerfed from 20 seconds to 10 seconds.
  • At upgrade 9, he can damage flying enemies and multi-hit (4 hits).
